maddeler.e:
أجنن (form I)
# أَجْنُنْ (ʔajnun) /ʔad͡ʒ.nun/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of جَنَّ (janna)
# أُجْنَنْ (ʔujnan) /ʔud͡ʒ.nan/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
